svg.aria-label: Sources/App: The launch with window, menus and RootView.; Sources/Core: Fixed values and choices: pages, settings, paths, constants.; Sources/Models: The data: Node, Entry, categories, cleanup kinds, app usage.; Sources/Services: The work without any interface: scan, search, clean up, report.; Sources/State: AppModel, which brings the services together.; Sources/DesignSystem: The UI building blocks with tokens, theme, surfaces and motion.; Sources/Features: Every page in a folder of its own, plus the shared table and grid.; Sources/Localization: TextKey and, in Resources, the texts in 28 languages.; Sources/Diagnostics: Self test, stress test, demo data and the page list.; Widget: The widget, a target of its own with a small design system.; Tests: Swift Testing for tree, search, pages, design, contrast and texts.
